title: BSidesSF 2026 - Google Drive Hunter: Building the Tool Google Should’ve Built (Ayman Elsawah)
description:
Google Drive Hunter: Building the Tool Google Should’ve Built

Ayman Elsawah

Google Drive Hunter is an open-source tool that uncovers externally shared files across your Workspace, classifies sensitive data with AI, and helps revoke risky shares. Built through “vibe coding,” this talk shares its evolution, my vibe coding journey, and a wild responsible disclosure story.
